notes.title: Anomaly Hunter (Free Demo) - sci-fi hidden object puzzler about time-travelling detective, Q4 2020
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/4464c0426ed107262061a73f6edcb3ff41c11eff.png[/img][/url]

[b]Anomaly Hunter[/b] - sci-fi hidden object puzzler about time-traveling detective.
This is first game by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/pub/hook][b]Hook Games[/b][/url] (ex Konstructors), so we would really appreciate your support.

Play as STID (Space & Time Integrity Department) detective, whose role is to find & fix time anomalies, which cause a lot of trouble all over the universe.

Why do they appear, who is hiding behind all of this - simple accident or evil villain? That's a mystery to solve.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31263647/d50b2b7cb4e876ae4d33cdb4e110e73087e7b4e1.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]15 original detailed worlds
    [*]Over 3 hours of fascinating gameplay
    [*]1000+ unique characters and objects, each with its story to tell
    [*]English, Chinese, German, Spanish, Ukrainian & Russian localizations
    [*]Gazillion of Easter eggs, most of them you won't find anyway ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
[/list]

[h1]Play free Demo & Wishlist:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301820/Anomaly_Hunter/

[i]Your best,
Hook Games[/i]

notes.title: Play for Free - Nonogram, Master's Legacy.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30619247/0cf8a83db03f5db1448f3ebf33a46c94b397efbc.png[/img]

[i] Nonograms, also known as Picross or Griddlers, are picture logic puzzles in which cells in a grid must be colored or left blank according to numbers at the side of the grid to reveal a hidden picture. [/i] © Wiki

[h1][b]Master's Legacy[/b][/h1]

Discover all beauty of Nonogram puzzles (multiple game modes, level sizes), master painting skills in Editor and share works with friends in Workshop. Become The Greatest. 

[h1][b]Play for Free[/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/742500/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy/

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Totally free - Starter Pack, Community Levels & Level Editor are available for everybody.
[*] Gorgeous Starter Pack - perfect 15 Nonogram levels to get you started and tease your brain for more adventure.
[*] Multiple DLC's with different game modes and level styles.
[*] Completed all levels? Don't worry! We have an endless list of user-made paintings, you'll never feel lonely.
[*] You should love to paint, do you? Go on and try our awesome level editor (up to 100x100 size), show those impostors who is the Greatest One here!
[*] Art design - clean and beautiful.
[*] Relaxing ambient soundtracks will keep your mind sharp and focused.
[/list]

[h1]Bought a game? Leave review![/h1]

Just want to remind you that your reviews are really important for us:
[olist]
[*] They help us better understand what you expect from a game, so we can improve it
[*] Reviews boost game visibility among Steam, which gives us more sales and we can make more cool games in the future :)
[/olist]

You can leave review [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/742500/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy/][b]here[/b][/url].


[h1][b]Magnificent puzzle packs[/b] (200+ puzzles)[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/957760/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy_The_Greatest_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/957761/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy_Classic_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/957762/Nonogram__Masters_Legacy_Speed_Pack/

[i]Thanks for your support,
Konstructors team[/i]

notes.title: March 22 - Nonogram, The Greatest
notes.content:
[img=https://i.imgur.com/T5niRzD.png]

Release date - [b]March 22[/b].
Check out our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c1kQICnIUh4]Launch trailer[/url], would love to hear your feedback in comments below!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/742490/Nonogram__The_Greatest_Painter/

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Over 200 handcrafted picross puzzles (colored, b&w and speed drawing) + Community levels
[*] Level editor (100x100 support)
[*] Workshop
[*] Weekly contests (Winner's levels will be added permanently, custom personal achievement, name in game credits. More details soon)
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Cloud saves
[/list]

[h1]Coming soon[/h1]
[list]
[*] Steam Trading Cards, Emoticons and Backgrounds
[*] Full controller support
[*] Mac & Linux support
[/list]

Hope you will love it! :)

[i] Thanks for staying with us,
Konstructors team[/i]

notes.title: The Greatest Painter
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/742490/Nonogram__The_Greatest_Painter/][img=https://i.imgur.com/gD3rxoe.png][/img][/url]

Announcing our second new game this year: [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/742490/Nonogram__The_Greatest_Painter/][b]Nonogram - The Greatest Painter[/b][/url].

[h1][b]The Greatest Painter[/b][/h1]
Excellent attempt in a world of Nonogram/Picross puzzles. Galore of levels, multiple game modes along with level editor & workshop would never disappoint any puzzle fan.

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Play through over 100 hand-crafted nonogram puzzles, both colored and B&W.
[*] Completed all levels? Don't worry! We have an endless list of user-made paintings, you'll never feel lonely.
[*] You should love to paint, do you? Go on and try our awesome level editor, show those impostors who is the Greatest One here!
[*] Art design - clean and beautiful.
[*] Relaxing ambient soundtracks will keep your mind sharp and focused.
[*] Lay down on your comfortable sofa, put controller in your hands and play - full controller support here!
[/list]

Nonogram - The Greatest Painter will be available on Steam [b]March 16[/b]. Add to [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/742490/Nonogram__The_Greatest_Painter/]Wishlist[/url] here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/742490/Nonogram__The_Greatest_Painter/

Join our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/groups/konstructors_entertainment]Steam group[/url] to stay updated.

[i]Thanks for staying with us! 
Konstructors team[/i]
